verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party pricing documentation, so a buyer cannot learn from Netlify itself whether pricing is per-seat or whether minimum seat counts apply. A community anecdote mentions Netlify trying to charge per user on a documentation repo, but it is not a documented pricing disclosure and says nothing about seat minimums. Another user reports being unable to find pricing at all without handing over contact details.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know whether pricing is per-seat with minimum seat counts that increase cost as my team grows
